predecessors.name: Principality of Regensburg
predecessors.text: Dalberg's own lands: Aschaffenburg, Frankfurt and Wetzlar

successors.name: Kingdom of Bavaria
successors.text: Aschaffenburg; the page says 'most of the territory of the grand duchy was ultimately annexed by the Kingdom of Bavaria'

successors.name: Free City of Frankfurt
successors.text: Frankfurt 'once again became a free city'

successors.name: Electorate of Hesse
successors.text: Hanau and Fulda (not on this page; see the electorate-of-hesse dossier)

ledger.x: 16 February 1810: Napoleon creates the Grand Duchy of Frankfurt for Dalberg.
1810: Hanau is combined into the grand duchy (with Fulda), 'Aschaffenburg, Wetzlar, Fulda, Hanau, and Frankfurt were combined'.
1810: Fulda is combined into the grand duchy.
December 1813: allied troops occupy the grand duchy, six weeks after Dalberg's abdication in favour of Eugène (26 October 1813).
December 1813: the Grand Duchy of Frankfurt ends.

wars.name: War of the Sixth Coalition (German campaign of 1813)
wars.outcome: After Napoleon's defeat at Leipzig the Rhine states fell away; Dalberg abdicated on 26 October 1813 and allied troops occupied the grand duchy in December 1813.

certainty.note: The page names five territories (Aschaffenburg, Wetzlar, Fulda, Hanau, Frankfurt) but no frontier; the dossier draws discs round the towns.
